notes:
# See what was saved {checkmark.circle}
When a recording ends, its page now shows what was kept: the audio, the
transcript and the notes, each marked Saved, Processing or Queued until it
lands.

# Pause the transcript from the recording page {pause.circle}
The live transcript card has Pause and Show over meeting. The recording
keeps going either way.

# A quicker meetings list {list.bullet}
Rows light up under the pointer. Shift-click picks a run of meetings in
Select. Return plays the one that is open, and the arrow keys no longer
throw away changes you have not saved.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Singapore English is no longer refused as "several languages" when a
  transcript is read again.
- A transcript opened before it was finished no longer says "0 words".
- Alone in a meeting, your own name is no longer given to the other voice.
- A meeting named in Chinese no longer stops the app noticing it is
  recording.
- Your phone says whether it is connected to a Mac or a PC.
- A phone disconnected while the Mac was asleep drops off Connected phones.
